question: Identify the number of distinct customers in the LAM segment who used CZK currency and had total annual consumption below 50,000 in any year from 2011 to 2013, excluding those whose monthly average consumption exceeded 5,000 in that same year.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_001")
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
  AND T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
  AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2012', '2013')
GROUP BY T1."XCL_001", SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4)
HAVING SUM(T2."XCL_021") < 50000
   AND (SUM(T2."XCL_021") / 12.0) <= 5000
